blindness: Limited: author knows historical policies; only business §6, public DTO and skill/program taxonomy were consulted during this task. No current comparator implementation, individual results, prior expected orders or new product ranking/admission output read/run.
semanticAuthoring: Manual employer-business0..3 label vectors; per-resume facts explain the decisions. Source-neutral adapter mapping is a subsequent separately hashed artifact.
postFreezePolicy: Do not tune on untouched_final. Once used for tuning, reclassify it diagnostic and author a new control. Preserve all old labels/results. Do not silently remove empty or adapter-unsupported cases.
emptyMetricConvention: P@k0 for empty; nDCG0 when positive ideal exists; nDCGnull when ideal denominator0; all case counts explicitly reported.
